description: This Java file defines an Android activity class 'FitDistanceWatchFaceConfigActivity' that allows users to link their Google Fit account to a wearable watch face. It handles Google Fit API connections, authorization, and user preferences for fitness data integration, including UI components like a switch to enable/disable Google Fit and managing connection states.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceConfigActivity
classes.description: Android activity for configuring Google Fit integration in the watch face app, managing connection to Google Fit API, user authorization, and preferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, restores saved state, and builds the GoogleApiClient for fitness APIs.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts the GoogleApiClient connection if Google Fit is enabled.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity stops.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from authorization resolution activities, and updates Google Fit preferences accordingly.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient successfully connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of the GoogleApiClient connection, logs cause, and updates UI state.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect to Google Fit, attempts resolution if possible, or shows error dialog.

methods.name: onSwitchClicked
methods.description: Triggered when user toggles the switch, enabling or disabling Google Fit integration, handling connection or disconnection accordingly.

methods.name: setUserFitPreferences
methods.description: Updates user preferences for Google Fit, persists to SharedPreferences, and updates the switch state.
